description.summary: agent leases: one window, an agent seat, masked capture, glow

protocol.description:
The private protocol between cuad (the computer-use daemon) and the quire fork of cosmic-comp. cuad leases one toplevel at a time. A lease binds four things to that window and to nothing else: an input seat of its own (the person's cursor and focus are untouched), a capture source whose buffers arrive masked, the glow and the agent's cursor, and the hardware kill chord's power to end it.
Stock cosmic-comp does not advertise these globals. cuad then reaches the compositor through ext-image-copy-capture (masking in cuad), the `com.system76.CosmicComp.Ei` D-Bus method for input, and the shell's own glow; see cua.md, "Fork changes against stock".
All coordinates are window-local logical pixels (the origin is the top-left of the window geometry, the same frame as the captured buffer after division by the output scale), except where a request says otherwise.
The manager is offered only to a client the compositor can name as cuad: through wp_security_context_v1 and an app-id allow-list in the fork. A client that binds it without being allow-listed is disconnected with `not_permitted`.
Warning: this protocol is a draft and may change. The server side lives in the fork (~/cosmic-comp, branch quire, src/quire/**); the client side is cuad's `cua-desktop` `cosmic` feature.

interface.name: quire_agent_manager_v1
interface.description: The global cuad binds. One manager per client; a second bind from another client while a lease exists is refused.

entry.name: not_permitted
entry.summary: the client is not the allow-listed cuad

entry.name: bad_mode
entry.summary: a mode value this version does not define

entry.name: lease_held
entry.summary: the toplevel already has a live lease

enum.name: lease_mode
enum.description: The same three values as docket-core's RunMode, in the same order.

entry.name: in_place
entry.summary: the window stays where the person has it

entry.name: agent_workspace
entry.summary: the window moves to a hidden workspace that keeps rendering

entry.name: nested_session
entry.summary: the window runs in a nested compositor

request.name: create_lease
request.description: Creates a lease on a toplevel. The compositor answers with `granted` (then `ei_socket` and `geometry`), or with `revoked` straight away if it will not grant it (a shell window, a window of another Space, a window that is gone). A lease never outlives the toplevel.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Existing leases stay valid until they are destroyed.

interface.name: quire_agent_lease_v1
interface.description: The lease is the unit of everything the agent may do. Destroying it, or the toplevel closing, or the kill chord, ends the agent seat, the capture source and the glow together.

description.summary: why a lease ended without cuad asking

entry.name: space_changed
entry.summary: the window left the run's Space

entry.name: compositor
entry.summary: the compositor withdrew or refused the lease

description.summary: why input stops without ending the lease

enum.name: glow_state

description.summary: what the run looks like from outside

enum.description: The values are cua-desktop's `GlowState::code`. Only `acting` reads the rectangle of `set_glow`.

entry.name: surface_declared
entry.summary: the app declared the region sensitive

entry.name: overlay_outside_lease
entry.summary: an overlay that is not part of the leased window

event.name: revoked
event.description: The last event; the client destroys the object. Sent also in answer to a refused `create_lease`.

event.name: ei_socket

description.summary: the EIS socket of this lease's agent seat

event.description: An EIS sender context bound to this lease's agent seat. Its absolute region is the window geometry, in window-local coordinates, so a click at (x, y) lands at (x, y) in the window. Focus is limited to the leased toplevel's surface tree (popups and subsurfaces included). Input never reaches layer-shell, session-lock or consent surfaces.

event.name: physical_input

description.summary: the person used the keyboard or pointer

event.description: Sent when physical input arrives while the lease is active, so cuad can pause the run. Coalesced: at most one per 100 ms.

event.name: geometry
event.description: The window's logical size and the output's scale in 120ths (wp_fractional_scale units). Sent after `granted` and on every change.

request.name: get_capture_source
request.description: Creates an ext_image_capture_source_v1 for this window. Buffers captured from it through the standard ext_image_copy_capture_manager_v1 arrive with the compositor's masks applied (text-input password purpose, quire_sensitive_v1 regions, `set_mask_hints`, and the sensitive-window rules) before the buffer leaves the compositor. The frame is cropped to the window geometry.

request.name: set_mask_hints
request.description: Replaces the hints. `hints` is an array of records, each five little-endian 32-bit unsigned integers: x, y, width, height (window-local logical pixels) and a mask_reason value. A length that is not a multiple of 20 bytes is a protocol error on the lease object.

request.name: set_glow

description.summary: draw the glow and the agent cursor

request.description: `x`, `y`, `width` and `height` are window-local logical pixels and are read only for `acting`; other states ignore them.

request.name: suspend
request.description: Input stops, the capture source and the glow stay. A repeated `suspend` replaces the reason.

description.summary: let the agent seat's input flow again

request.name: destroy
request.description: Ends the agent seat (held keys and buttons are released), the capture source and the glow.
